info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Sodalite Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Sodalite Pendant Detail Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed information about sodalite pendants in the catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to add new details, including descriptions, specifications, and images, enhancing product visibility and customer engagement. Common consumers include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems looking to enrich their catalog offerings. By utilizing this API, developers can ensure that product details are comprehensive and up-to-date, ultimately improving the shopping experience.

post.summary: Create a new detail for a sodalite pendant.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information for a specific sodalite pendant. It expects the necessary information in the request body and returns the created detail object upon successful creation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details related to the sodalite pendant. It should contain all necessary information for processing the request, structured according to the specified schema.
